BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsappachath, meaning a saucer (as flat). It appears 7 times in Scripture, including 1 Samuel 26:11 and 1 Kings 17:12.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsappachath matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
